deployment.speech: SpeechServices S0, westeurope, local/key authentication disabled
deployment.hosting: Single Linux App Service B1 instance, Python 3.12, one worker with threads
deployment.identity: System-assigned managed identity; Cognitive Services Speech User on the new Speech resource only
deployment.scope: Only the application resource group explicitly supplied to deployment

rejectedAlternatives.reason: Browser can decode the same Azure authorization credential. Fails the boundary policy.
A custom endpoint is needed for Entra authentication, but does not remove browser authorization material.
Modifying a signed token is not a supported authorization or policy solution.
A blank player passes a naive token scan but fails the actual media acceptance criteria.

reviewGate.rule: Passing automation makes the PR reviewable, never approved.

knownTradeoffs: The official Python sample uses SpeechSDKInternal-ExtraTurnStartMessage; pin the SDK and require a live compatibility check.
Transient TURN/ICE credentials and media endpoint network addresses remain browser-visible by design.
One-process session ownership is suitable for this small demo, not a horizontally scaled production service.
Operator authorization is a scoped high-entropy application token exchanged for a short-lived HttpOnly cookie, not full enterprise SSO.
